content: Hello! How can I assist you with your account today?
Hi, I need to update my password for the subscriber portal but I’m not sure where to start.
No problem. First, please go to the portal homepage and click on the 'Account Settings' button near the top right.
Okay, I see it. It’s asking for my username and current password.
Great. Please enter your registered email address as your username, along with your current password to continue.
Done. Now it’s showing an option to change my password.
Perfect. Click on 'Change Password', then type in your new password twice to confirm.
I’ve updated it. Do I need to do anything else?
Just click 'Save Changes' to complete the update. You’ll receive a confirmation email at your registered address.
Got it, thanks for your help!
